actual_grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
edits ::= "[" space edits-item ("," space edits-item){0,15} space "]"
edits-item ::= "{" space edits-item-changes-kv "," space edits-item-node-kv space "}"
edits-item-changes ::= "{" space edits-item-changes-text-kv space "}"
edits-item-changes-kv ::= "\"changes\"" space ":" space edits-item-changes
edits-item-changes-text-kv ::= "\"text\"" space ":" space string
edits-item-node ::= ("\"api.rs/span/n10\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n11\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n3\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n4\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n5\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n6\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n7\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n8\"" | "\"api.rs/span/n9\"" | "\"client.rs/entrypoint/n4\"" | "\"client.rs/entrypoint/n5\"" | "\"client.rs/entrypoint/n6\"" | "\"client.rs/entrypoint/n7\"")
edits-item-node-kv ::= "\"node\"" space ":" space edits-item-node
edits-kv ::= "\"edits\"" space ":" space edits
root ::= "{" space edits-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
scope: retained actual V12 grammar exposes changes-before-node; raw full records remain in V12 archive
